label: restart-by-environment-name waitReady false round 0 (warm-up)
why: T24 timing, window-only: restarts the application for every user. Both servers read the mode (the application and both sessions are up), then each side sends the restart request alone 120 s after the previous call, as window/t15.json does: the first side's request reaches a running application, the second side's is the first request after the first side's restart. A last read brings the application up again. Run with --order alternate: the first side flips with every round.

steps.why: clio's tool takes flat arguments (environmentName), so the read goes through clio-run on both sides, as in window/t12.json. It is an authenticated GetApplicationInfo call: it also brings each server's session and the stand's application up before the timed step.
